description: This Java class 'ProviderAttribute' represents a user-defined attribute associated with a provider entity in the OpenMRS healthcare system. It extends 'BaseAttribute' and implements 'Attribute', providing methods to get and set the provider attribute ID and the associated provider.

classes.name: ProviderAttribute
classes.description: Represents a specific attribute linked to a provider, including getter and setter methods for its ID and associated provider.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique identifier for this provider attribute.

methods.name: setProviderAttributeId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this provider attribute.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Returns the provider object associated with this attribute by calling getOwner().

methods.name: setProvider
methods.description: Associates a provider object with this attribute by calling setOwner(provider).

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Overrides method to get the ID of the attribute, returning providerAttributeId.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Overrides method to set the ID of the attribute, assigning providerAttributeId.
